claims.statement: Exact deterministic representation regret is max over fibres of min action max statewise regret; epsilon-safe actions are nonempty exactly below the fibre value.
Randomized representation regret is the finite minimax expected-loss LP under ex-ante state-adversary semantics.
Deterministic and randomized minimax regret are nonincreasing under representation refinement before acquisition cost.
Every deterministic m-action worst fibre has an exact witness on at most m states.
Minimal epsilon-action conflicts have size at most the action count, and global static epsilon-safety is exactly weighted set cover on the induced conflict hypergraph.

Deterministic adaptive refinement with state-dependent acquisition cost is exactly the minimum infinity norm over recursively achievable statewise loss profiles; componentwise Pareto pruning is exact.
A continuation-independent scalar Bellman charge is universally exact if and only if acquisition cost is constant on the reached observation cell.
Adaptive acquisition weakly dominates every fixed static feature set and the static/adaptive gap is unbounded.

Randomized adaptive value is the minimax game over deterministic loss profiles; dominated profiles may be removed, an optimum uses at most the fibre size in deterministic trees, and a dual adversarial prior plus Bayes Bellman trace supplies an exact lower certificate.
Frozen low-order representations have nonzero exact target diameter in the complete graph, set-cover and 2-SAT panels totaling 230378 instances.
The six-vertex cycle-count repair does not transfer to the complete seven-vertex graph atlas; registered graphlet and composite repairs are target sufficient on that finite atlas.
On SAT12-ALL, exhaustive evaluation of 513 dependency-closed static representations selects Pre+lobjois with robust total excess 1712 versus 12000 for no features and 16906.55 for all features.
The frozen SAT static procedure fails strict robust held-out transfer on both source-CV and group-disjoint splits while retaining mean excess improvement.
The timeout-first tail-aware selector passes both registered splits in ASP and graph matching and fails both in MiniZinc/CSP.

Per-solver random-forest runtime regression dominates the exact robust cell action on the same selected representation and cost on both splits in BNSL and TSP; MIP is mixed because no features are selected.
Oracle-action random-forest classification is split-sensitive in BNSL and strongly adverse in TSP under the frozen protocol.

Exact fibres provide representation-owned impossibility, safety, conflict and failure certificates; learned runtime models may supply the operational action map within that audited information budget.
FiberGuard's exact robust cell action is superior to learned algorithm selectors.
Complete-corpus fibre exactness implies unseen-instance or family-generalization safety.
Failure-aware mean/tail improvement implies lower robust maximum or distribution-free tail safety.
The results reproduce under independent code/custody and current strongest configured or censor-aware selectors.
The residual contribution is novel and sufficient for a top-tier journal.
